parameters.name: AccountDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the account. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.
